summary.text: Resolving date ambiguity for the Oct 23 pizza plan by ensuring natural timestamped iMessage dialogue among three members.
Adding a clarification step to disambiguate the Friday date without redundant month or year.
Extending the dialogue to include Leo joining via Maya’s DM and aligning voice traits with a morning time window.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: morninggg my legs are dead
Leo: leg day again?
Maya: yesterday lol i can barely do stairs today
Me: oof stairs still hurt for you?
Maya: yes send help
Leo: never go back to leg day
Me: hahaha still stuck in my head
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Leo: crying suit guy lives on
Me: i need coffee so bad this morning
Maya: same, i'm on cup two already at my desk
Leo: i'm still in line for coffee, this place is slow
Me: did your laptop survive this morning?
Leo: barely, froze once already
Maya: ugh classic ghosted by IT energy
Me: mine was dragging right at like 9
Leo: did you do the restart thing?
Me: not yet, i just opened everything and prayed
Maya: that's the full toolkit right there
Leo: lol rude but accurate
Me: it's freezing this morning again huh
Maya: yes wore the heavy jacket in
Leo: same, fall jacket uniform continues
Me: i walked in and my hands were numb
Maya: need tea after this coffee tbh
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: sooo what's everyone up to today, slow work day?
Maya: meetings till like 11 then actually free
Leo: i have standup in 20 then nothing
Me: lucky, i have dishes from breakfast already piled up at home lol
Maya: the never ending dishes
Leo: put that sketch on in the background, makes it faster
Me: the pizza ad one?
Leo: yeah trailer voice makes scrubbing dramatic
Maya: okay so random but can i pull something from dms in here
Me: yeah of course
Leo: oh no what
Maya: me and you were talking about doing pizza next friday
Me: oh yeah Rosa's?
Maya: yes! Rosa's on Oak Street
Leo: ooo i haven't been there
Maya: we said the 23rd at noon cuz we're both off that friday
Me: yeah noon on the 23rd works for me
Leo: wait you guys already locked that in?
Maya: kinda yeah in dms last night, but i wanted to add you here so you can come too
Leo: i'm down, i love rosa's
Me: you been before?
Leo: once ages ago, crust was so good
Maya: so can you do the 23rd at noon too?
Leo: yeah that works for me
Me: yay okay the three of us then
Maya: perfect, meet out front like usual?
Leo: bet, parking over there isn't awful right?
Me: way better than Pine Street, you'll be fine
Maya: i can bus over easy
Me: i can walk from work, like 10 mins
Leo: good cuz i circled forever at mario's last time
Maya: lol you did
Me: garlic knots energy but rosa's version?
Maya: they do those parmesan ones i think
Leo: as long as no salty olive bomb like last time
Maya: ugh no, those olives were way too salty
Me: yeah crust was perfect otherwise
Leo: exactly, skip olives forever
Maya: anyway you in for real for the 23rd?
Leo: yeah i'm in, noon at rosa's
Me: nice, can't wait
Leo: my kitchen is a mess again btw
Me: nooo you cleared the sink ecosystem!
Maya: reboot already?
Leo: rude but accurate, it lasted like four days
Me: new record at least?
Maya: growth is slow
Leo: i'll put that sketch on while i do dishes tonight
Me: same, endless dishes cycle
Maya: trailer voice makes everything dramatic
Me: never go back to workkkk while scrubbing pans
Maya: HAHAHA stop
Leo: anyone wanna do that cooking game later tonight?
Maya: maybe one round, depends how sore i get
Me: i could join for one, no promises i won't burn stuff
Leo: two fires max, house rule
Maya: hey that's my rule
Me: lol she owns it now
Maya: okay i need more tea, i'm still cold in here
Leo: weird lemon one again please
Me: chamomile me up round two
Maya: got you both
Leo: so 23rd, out front at noon, i'll text when i'm close
Maya: perfect, same
Me: same, i'll walk over",
  "writer_note": "Set the chat on a chilly work morning to match the 9-11:30 window and used next-Friday / the 23rd language to pin October 23 without over-formal dates. Maya ported the DM plan for Rosa's on Oak Street at noon into the group and got a short explicit yes from Leo, with everyday noise about coffee, leg day, IT issues, dishes, tea, and the running olive and cooking-game jokes to keep voices consistent."
}
